reason: The provided filing text appears to be from IVR (Internationale Vereinigung des Rheinschifffahrtsregisters), which is an association for inland navigation, not from Besi (BE Semiconductor Industries N.V.). The document contains annual reports in German, Dutch, French and English about inland shipping/navigation activities, conferences, and technical committees. There is no mention of Besi, semiconductor equipment, or any TAM disclosure related to the Information Technology sector. The filing appears to be incorrectly matched to ticker BESI.AS.
